body.name: same-dimension BLCM domain \(\mathcal C_K(P_X)\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal C_K(P_X)=\{(G',P',\Gamma',\Lambda',\pi',p'):\ H'\in\mathcal Q^K,\ X\in\mathcal Q^J;\ G'\text{ is a DAG with latent-to-latent and latent-to-observed edges only};\ P'\text{ factorizes over }G';\ P'(H'=h)>0\text{ for every }h;\ P'\text{ is faithful to }G';\text{ distinct configurations of }H'_{\operatorname{pa}_{\Gamma'}(j)}\text{ give distinct laws of }X_j\text{ for every }j;\text{ no two latent observed-child sets contain one another};\ \sum_hP'(X=x,H'=h)=P_X(x)\text{ for every }x\in\mathcal Q^J\}\). Neither double triangularity, the certificate, third-view coverage, nor knowledge of \(S_1,S_2\) is imposed on an alternative realization.
